Place the locally built FFmpegKitNext Web package here so this directory contains:

  dist/index.js
  lib/...

Required build features for this project:
  libass, fontconfig, freetype, fribidi, harfbuzz,
  x264, x265, libsvtav1, pthreads, ffprobe.

Upstream: https://github.com/arthenica/ffmpeg-kit-next
The package is not published on npm; it must be built locally.
